summary: OpenAI announced expansion of ChatGPT for Teachers to 55 additional U.S. school districts covering over 100,000 more educators, plus a 16-state data privacy agreement framework for districts.

practices.reason: A shared national data privacy agreement changes the governance/procurement path for districts adopting the tool, though it is not a technical integration change for engineering teams.
practices.quote: We’re introducing a 16-state National Data Privacy Agreement through the Student Data Privacy Consortium framework, giving districts in participating states a recognized path to evaluate and adopt ChatGPT for Teachers without negotiating separate agreements district by district.
